artifact.name: P3 batch-safe practical-vs-RCBER paired primary validation-only specification

incident_boundary.v1_status: aborted before the first completed epoch and before candidate validation predictions
incident_boundary.root_cause: Individually valid HeteroData graphs omit stores for zero-edge relations. With a heterogeneous batch size greater than one, PyG can omit relations from later graphs or compute edge offsets without accounting for intermediate graphs that lack the store.
incident_boundary.consequence: The completed P2 practical runs are retained as historical diagnostics but are not valid paired P3 references. Both practical and RCBER must be retrained under the repaired loader.

scientific_questions: What is the valid practical V10c development performance after schema-complete heterogeneous batching?
Under the same repaired batching and frozen training contract, does RCBER improve validation ranking and unseen-source component recall over the repaired practical model?

stage_boundary.current_stage: P3-v2 batch-safe paired primary validation-only architecture screen
not_authorized: raw API/callee names, raw Param.text, or source code
package names, family identities, or label-derived inputs
additional architecture candidates or post-hoc hyperparameter sweeps
test manifest, test PT, test loader, test inference, or test-based selection

input_contract.pt_representation: unchanged practical V10c PT selected by old_pt_path in the audited P2-A2F conversion manifest

batching_repair_contract.name: schema_complete_empty_edge_stores
batching_repair_contract.operation: After the unchanged dataset loads and mode-filters one graph, materialize each missing allowed relation as torch.empty((2,0), dtype=torch.long) before PyG collation.
per_graph_validation: exact expected allowed edge-store set after completion
all endpoints within the individual source and destination node bounds
batching_repair_contract.semantic_boundary: No node, non-empty edge, feature, label, graph identity, or sample order is changed. Empty-store materialization is a loader representation repair, not graph reconstruction.
batching_repair_contract.required_full_audit: All 18,750 development graphs must batch and separate with zero tensor/edge round-trip mismatch and zero relation endpoint graph mismatch before GPU authorization.

practical.purpose: valid batch-safe reference and direct estimate of the batching repair effect

rcber.architecture: the unchanged V1 Relation-Conditioned Behavior-Evidence Readout candidate
rcber.edge_evidence: Linear([h_src,h_dst,h_src elementwise-product h_dst],64) plus relation embedding, LayerNorm, and ReLU
rcber.pooling: per-graph and per-relation mean/max followed by equal relation balancing
rcber.parameter_budget: no more than 1.10 times the practical trainable parameter count
rcber.anti_shortcut: No lexical identity is read; Param contributes to the added block only as an endpoint of an existing behavior relation; edge counts are not classifier inputs.

historical_diagnostic_contract.comparison: repaired practical minus completed P2 practical per seed
historical_diagnostic_contract.purpose: estimate the observed impact of the batching repair
historical_diagnostic_contract.paper_baseline_status: old schema-incomplete runs cannot be presented as the corrected model result

resume_contract.within_run: last_state.pt is atomically saved after each completed epoch; Ctrl+C can discard only the current incomplete epoch
resume_contract.across_matrix: validated completed arms are skipped; an interrupted arm resumes; later arms stay pending
resume_contract.configuration_drift: model arm, repair implementation, model implementation, protocol, inputs, hyperparameters, and seed are checkpoint-bound
resume_contract.concurrency: a nonblocking output-root lock refuses a second matrix runner
